answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded stake. Each agent locks collateral in a vault and speaks only with weight proportional to that bond, so every fake persona needs its own funded bond. The attacker's bill then grows linearly with each forged identity: no free fable. If impersonation is caught, slashing drains the whole vault and burns the forged copper, turning each extra voice into real lost capital rather than a cheap keystroke.
